content_sections.heading: PAU Young Professional-II (YP-II) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the age limit.

content_sections.heading: About PAU Regional Research Station, Faridkot
content_sections.text: Punjab Agricultural University is based in Ludhiana, Punjab, and its Regional Research Station at Faridkot issued this notice. The post is in ad hoc projects at the Faridkot station, which work on cotton breeding and cotton insect pest and disease management.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists the YP-II post under two projects. It does not print the number of posts under either project.

rows.name_of_the_project_and_title: Development of high yielding and climate resilient BG II G. hirsutum Varieties/Hybrids suitable for North Zone (Faridkot) MCP 1.2.1
Integrated management strategies for major and emerging insect pests and diseases of cotton through assessment of seasonal abundance, diversity and resistance monitoring MCP 3.2

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: B.Sc. Agri./B.Sc. Biotech/B.Sc. Hort./B.Sc. Forestry with minimum OCPA 6.00/10.00 or 60%. Master degree in any Agriculture science subject with minimum marks OGPA 3.40/4.00 or OCPA 6.50/10.00 or 65%. Research experience in Plant Breeding, Genetics & Biotechnology, reflected through research publications/Masters research. Knowledge of Punjabi up to Matric level. Preference will be given to a candidate having higher educational qualification and experience in Plant Breeding. B.Sc. (Life Sciences)/B.Sc. Agri./B.Sc. Biotech/B.Sc. Hort./B.Sc. Forestry with minimum OCPA 6.00/10.00 or 60%. Master degree in any Agriculture science subject/Life sciences with minimum marks OGPA 3.40/4.00 or OCPA 6.50/10.00 or 65%. Research experience in Insect Science, reflected through research publications/Masters research. Knowledge of Punjabi up to Matric level. Preference will be given to a candidate having higher educational qualification and research experience in Insect Science. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each project.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay for the YP-II post is Rs. 42,000/- p.m fixed under both projects. The post is filled on contract basis and is initially for six months or till the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The services of the incumbent are liable to be terminated at any time without any prior notice.

content_sections.heading: PAU Young Professional-II (YP-II) Job Description
content_sections.text: To conduct laboratory and field research work as per objectives of the project. Any other duty that may be assigned from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PAU Young Professional-II (YP-II)
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form from the office of the Director, PAU Regional Research Station, Faridkot, by depositing a bank draft of Rs.200 in favour of The Comptroller, PAU payable at Faridkot. Fill in the application on the prescribed form. Attach self attested copies of the certificates. Submit the application at the office of Director, P.A.U. Regional Research Station, Circular Road, Faridkot, to be received on or before 07.12.2026. Prescribed application form with the bank draft of Rs.200. Self attested copies of the certificates, with the application. Original copies of the testimonials, to be brought at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Interested candidates are to appear before the selection committee for interview on 11.12.2026 at 11.00 AM in the office of Director, Regional Research Station, Faridkot. No separate letter for the interview will be issued. The notice states a preference for higher educational qualification and experience in Plant Breeding for the first project, and for higher educational qualification and research experience in Insect Science for the second.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU YP-II post at Faridkot?
faq.answer: The application with self attested copies of the certificates is to be received at the office of Director, PAU Regional Research Station, Faridkot, on or before 07.12.2026.

faq.question: Q2. When is the PAU YP-II interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 11.12.2026 at 11.00 AM in the office of Director, Regional Research Station, Faridkot. No separate letter for the interview will be issued.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for PAU YP-II?
faq.answer: A B.Sc. in the listed subjects with minimum OCPA 6.00/10.00 or 60%, and a Master degree in an agriculture science subject with minimum OGPA 3.40/4.00, OCPA 6.50/10.00 or 65%. Research experience in the project's field and Punjabi up to Matric level are also listed.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the PAU Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 42,000/- p.m fixed for both projects.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for PAU YP-II?
faq.answer: The prescribed form is obtained by depositing a bank draft of Rs.200 in favour of The Comptroller, PAU payable at Faridkot.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the PAU YP-II post?
faq.answer: Take the prescribed form from the office of the Director, PAU Regional Research Station, Faridkot, and submit it there with self attested copies of the certificates by 07.12.2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is the PAU YP-II post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract post in an ad hoc project, initially for six months or till the termination of the project, whichever is earlier, and the services are liable to be terminated at any time without prior notice.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the PAU interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What should I bring to the PAU YP-II interview?
faq.answer: Bring the original copies of the testimonials to the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Which projects is the YP-II post in?
faq.answer: One is the project on high yielding and climate resilient BG II G. hirsutum varieties/hybrids (ICAR-122, PC 2830). The other is the project on management of insect pests and diseases of cotton (ICAR-124, PC 2832).
